app.routes: Access control lives in Prisma where clauses (creator or assignee) instead of Postgres row-level security, so queries stay typed and simple. Cost: Prisma bypasses RLS, so a check missed in a new route exposes data.
app.mw: Middleware reads the cookie session and skips /api, while each handler calls getUser itself, instead of verifying every request in one place. Cost: one extra Supabase Auth call per API request, and the page guard is only a redirect.
supabase.realtime: Realtime events only invalidate the query cache and trigger a refetch, instead of applying the payload, because payloads carry no joined rows such as the assignee. Cost: every change event costs an extra API round trip.
gemini: The Shift Brief streams Gemini output as server-sent events, so text appears at once instead of after the full response. Cost: a timeout or mid-stream failure ends the brief with an error, and nothing is cached or retried.
